evidence.summary: Round 4 closes VER2 S3/F1 on cip: shipment_evidence_current picks each identity's current row over all rows before row security (helper used only for scoped callers), and rows with no product in shipment_evidence_observation / shipment_evidence_line / fact_inbound_shipment inherit their identity's resolved product, else are visible/editable only under an open scope or to role steward. On cip after 0026: no-lines planner sees 0 rows in the view and the three tables (before 2532 / 5876 / 5896 / 546); NB planner view 8758 = decision; steward no-lines 495 = truly unresolved current rows. Helpers are SECURITY INVOKER with pinned search_path, restore the caller's setting (asserted), EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC. Role bound from app_user.role via the router (same source as require_roles); every scoped transaction writes it ('' when unknown).

rationale: The decision's visibility is enforced in the database for every scope the app produces, measured on cip with 0 mismatches. Limitations stated: the setting-based gate is not a boundary against arbitrary SQL as role cip (unchanged); four non-shipment tables still show rows with no product to all scopes pending Warren's decision; fact_inbound_shipment inclusion to be confirmed by Warren.
